turns.text: 2:22 am update. rate my parenting: i put the diaper on backwards, twice 🙃 and now he's refusing his bottle. is bottle refusal a big deal or am i just being dramatic? (typing one-handed sorry)

Backwards diapers happen to everyone, so that's a normal night. Occasional bottle refusal is usually common in babies, especially when they're tired, gassy, or the formula or nipple is new. Try a slightly different position, a calmer room, and offering small amounts more often. It's worth calling the pediatrician if he refuses several feeds in a row, has fewer wet diapers than usual, seems unusually sleepy, or has a fever. If he's still taking some milk and has normal wet diapers, it's usually just a rough night. Want me to help with anything while you're up?

ok good, thanks. so since i'm up anyway: can you make a quick printable sleep and feeding cheat sheet for my wife and the grandparents? one page, easy to skim. i take the 2 am feed and hana takes the 5 am, so it should list that. also he's on the new gentle formula that dr. fong recommended for his fussiness, put that on there

Absolutely. Here's a one-page design:

[Image: A clean, portrait-orientation printable page with a soft blue header reading "Baby's Sleep & Feeding Cheat Sheet". Below it are three rounded boxes with icons.

Box 1, "Night Feeds": a small moon icon, "2 a.m. feed: Dad" and "5 a.m. feed: Mom", with a blank line for the time of the last feed.

Box 2, "Formula": a bottle icon, "Now on the gentle formula recommended by Dr. Fong for fussiness. Please don't swap brands." Below it, a blank line for ounces per feed.

Box 3, "Sleep": a cloud icon and blank lines for nap times.

The footer has a "Notes / questions" area with ruled lines.]

Want me to add anything else, like diaper counts or an emergency contact section?
yes please. add a sleep note that he sleeps in the bassinet beside our bed, and leave a spot where i can add a crib later. also a diaper tally would be great

Here's the updated version:

[Image: The same one-page sheet with the blue header, now with an expanded "Sleep" box. It reads "Sleeps in: bassinet beside our bed" with a checked box, and underneath an empty unchecked box labeled "Crib (update date: ____)" so you can fill it in later. Beside the nap lines is a small "Safe sleep: on his back, nothing in the sleep space" reminder.

A new "Diaper Tally" strip runs across the bottom with two rows of small circles labeled "Wet" and "Dirty" for tick marks, plus a "Date" line. The Night Feeds and Formula boxes are unchanged.]

It's ready to print on regular letter paper. If you'd like, I can make a larger-font version for easier reading in a dim room.
